notes.id: Kindergarten 1: development Rp12.000.000, tuition Rp22.560.000/tahun. Nursery 1 Rp23,6 jt + Rp19,2 jt; K2 Rp6 jt + Rp23,64 jt. Development fee dibayar sekali di awal masuk (lumpsum), besarnya tergantung kelas masuk. Tuition bisa dibayar bulanan, per semester, atau tahunan.
notes.en: Kindergarten 1: development Rp12,000,000, tuition Rp22,560,000/yr. Nursery 1 Rp23.6M + Rp19.2M; K2 Rp6M + Rp23.64M. Development fee is paid once on entry (lump sum) and depends on the entry grade. Tuition can be paid monthly, per semester or yearly.
